And you know, somebody else writes code somewhere else and like the compiler now, you know, conveys the message from the person who wrote down the types to the person who's trying to change something that uses those types in a way that really helps large groups of people coordinate more effectively. And now, when we have all these AIs running around, a whole bunch of like virtual people who are also operating in the code base, it feels like it provides useful structures there as well.
